params.name: currency_pair
params.description: Concatenated string of the two currencies traded, e.g. "USDEUR". More than one pair can be entered, separated by a comma e.g. "EURGBP,GBPUSD,EURUSD".

params.name: on_behalf_of
params.description: A contact UUID for the sub-account you're acting on behalf of.

params.name: ignore_invalid_pairs
params.description: Ignore the validation of currency pairs.

items.docs:
Gets indicative foreign exchange rate information for one or more currency pairs in a single request.

This endpoint is intended to provide an indication of the rate available in the market and can support requests for multiple currency pairs, so is good for polling requirements such as live FX ticker widgets. This endpoint should be used where speed, availability and the ability to request multiple currency pairs is important.

params.name: fixed_side
params.description: Fix the buy or sell currency.

params.name: amount
params.description: Amount of the fixed buy or sell currency.

params.name: on_behalf_of
params.description: A contact UUID for the sub-account you're acting on behalf of.

params.name: conversion_date
params.description: Date of delivery of purchased currency. ISO 8601 format YYYY-MM-DD. If not specified, deals settle in two working days.

params.name: conversion_date_preference
params.description:
Available only if conversion_date is not provided. Must be one of the following:
'earliest' for earliest available conversion date. Make sure there is sufficient time to send funds to Currencycloud.
'next_day' for next day available conversion date - T+1.
'default' for conversion - T+1 for APAC restricted currencies, T+2 for all others.
'optimize_liquidity' for maximizing chances of getting a successful rate. Most relevant for exotic pairs. Conversion is T+0 for APAC restricted currencies, and T+1 or T+2 for all others.

items.docs:
Gets a detailed, tradeable rate quote to convert money from one currency to another. The quotation provided will be based on the spread table of the authenticated user. There is also the option to provide a specific date for the conversion to occur.
